cues.zh: 你有没有注意到，老式汽车的车头灯都长得一模一样？
cues.en: Have you ever noticed that old cars all have the same headlights?

cues.zh: 尽管整个20世纪，汽车造型千奇百怪、狂野依旧，
cues.en: Although automotive styling was all over the place and wild as ever throughout the 20th century,

cues.zh: 但从1940年起，车头灯始终是那种凸眼般的圆形玻璃。
cues.en: from 1940 onwards headlights were always the same bug-eyed circles of glass.

cues.zh: 有时它们会小一点，车两侧各装两个，
cues.en: Sometimes they might be a little smaller and there’d be two on each side of the car,

cues.zh: 到了七十年代，我们才得以享受
cues.en: and by the seventies we were afforded the luxury

cues.zh: 矩形车灯的奢侈待遇。
cues.en: of rectangles.

cues.zh: 但直到1980年代，在美国销售的每一辆轿车、卡车、自卸卡车和巴士，车头灯都大同小异。
cues.en: But until the 1980’s, every car, truck, dump truck, and bus sold in the United States had more-or-less identical headlights.

cues.zh: 这到底是怎么回事？
cues.en: What was up with that?

cues.zh: 答案是一个好主意变成了法规，
cues.en: The answer is a good idea that got turned into a regulation

cues.zh: 而这法规又持续得稍微久了点。
cues.en: that would then go on to go on a little too long.

cues.zh: 过去的那些车头灯被称为封闭光束前照灯，
cues.en: Those headlights of the past are known as sealed beam headlamps,

cues.zh: 它们的概念跟PAR灯——即抛物面镀铝反射灯——差不多。
cues.en: and they’re more or less the same concept as a PAR lamp, or parabolic aluminized reflector.

cues.zh: 我是说，我猜它们属于PAR灯，只是更具体的一个子类。
cues.en: I mean, I guess they are PAR lamps just a more specific subset.

cues.zh: 而从今天的视角看，可能略显离谱的部分是
cues.en: And the part that might seem slightly bonkers from today's perspective

cues.zh: 当你的前照灯烧坏时，你会去汽车配件店买……
cues.en: is that when you had a headlight go out, you would go to the auto parts store and obtain…

cues.zh: 一整个前照灯。
cues.en: an entire headlight.

cues.zh: 没错，实际上，这就是那个灯泡。
cues.en: That’s right, for all intents and purposes, this is the bulb.

cues.zh: 其实严格来说并不完全是，以正确的角度透过前玻璃看，你会看到反射器底部安放着一个卤素灯泡，
cues.en: In fact it’s not exactly, look through the front glass at the right angle and you’ll see a halogen bulb just chilling at the base of the reflector,

cues.zh: 但没办法只更换那个灯泡。
cues.en: but there’s no way to replace just that.

cues.zh: 当它烧坏时，整个东西就被扔掉了。
cues.en: When it burns out, this entire thing gets tossed.

cues.zh: 这款灯如今以12V版本作为H6024出售。
cues.en: This lamp is sold today in 12V versions as H6024.

cues.zh: 前照灯的电气连接器上有三个引脚，因为有两个灯丝：
cues.en: The headlight has three pins on its electrical connector because there are two filaments:

cues.zh: 一个用于近光或会车光束，另一个用于远光（你可能知道它叫行驶光束或主光束）。
cues.en: one for the low or dipped beam and other for the high beam (you might know it as the driving or main beam).

cues.zh: 虽然它们彼此非常接近，
cues.en: Although they’re very close to each other,

cues.zh: 但它们位于抛物面反射器焦点附近，根据点亮的是哪根灯丝，会产生截然不同的光束图案。
cues.en: their position near the focal point of the parabolic reflector results in a very different beam pattern depending on which filament is lit.

cues.zh: 现在，你可能会想，
cues.en: Now, you might be thinking,

cues.zh: “好吧……所以以前的车头灯就是这些大玻璃玩意儿，它们把远光和近光功能合二为一。
cues.en: “OK... so headlights used to be these big glass things and they had a combined high and low beam function.

cues.zh: 那又怎样。”
cues.en: Whoop-de-doo.”

cues.zh: 但你要知道，这可不是“随便一款”车头灯，
cues.en: But you see, this wasn’t just “a” headlight,

cues.zh: 这是“那款”车头灯。
cues.en: this was THE headlight.

cues.zh: 在十七年间，每一辆售出的汽车都被要求配备两个这样的东西。
cues.en: For seventeen years, every car sold was required to have two of these things.

cues.zh: 而在美国，直到1984款车型年，我们才放弃封闭式光束车头灯的想法。
cues.en: And in the US, we wouldn’t give up the idea of sealed beam headlights until the 1984 model year.

cues.zh: 今天，这听起来可能很荒谬。
cues.en: Today, this might sound absurd.

cues.zh: 而1984年已经晚得离谱了——
cues.en: And 1984 was ridiculously late -

cues.zh: 我们的联邦机动车安全标准有着长期落后于世界其他地区几十年的传统，
cues.en: our Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards have a long tradition of being decades behind the rest of the world,

cues.zh: 至少在照明要求方面是如此。
cues.en: at least when it comes to lighting requirements.

cues.zh: 我是说，我们居然还允许车尾用红色转向灯！
cues.en: I mean, we still allow red turn signals in the rear!

cues.zh: 应该有人做个视频讲讲这有多荒唐。
cues.en: Somebody oughta make a video about how silly that is.

cues.zh: 但这其实并不完全是个坏主意，
cues.en: But this wasn’t entirely a bad idea,

cues.zh: 事实上，这些年下来，它反倒显露出一些意想不到的优势。
cues.en: and in fact as the years have gone on this has proven to have some unexpected advantages.

cues.zh: 你可能会问，我们当初为什么要这么做？
cues.en: You might ask, why’d we do this in the first place?

cues.zh: 那咱们倒回1930年代。
cues.en: Well, let’s rewind to the 1930’s.

cues.zh: 汽车这玩意儿开始变得相当流行，
cues.en: These automobile things are starting to get pretty popular,

cues.zh: 而每个厂商在营销噱头上都各凭灵感，
cues.en: and with every manufacturer following their own inner light when it came to marketing gimmicks

cues.zh: （也包括各自去找供应商），
cues.en: (and also just finding suppliers for things),

cues.zh: 市面上就出现了乱七八糟的灯具大杂烩。
cues.en: an ungodly mishmash of lighting equipment was out there.

cues.zh: 当然，那时我们已经定下了用电气灯，
cues.en: Sure, we had settled on electric lights at this point,

cues.zh: 大多数厂商甚至已经搞明白了近光灯和远光灯那套东西，
cues.en: and most manufacturers had even figured out the whole dipped beam and driving beam thing,

cues.zh: 但由于没有既定标准……
cues.en: but with no established standard...

cues.zh: 祝你好运，在斯克内克塔迪郊外自驾游时还能找到备用灯泡。
cues.en: well good luck going on a road trip and finding a spare bulb outside of Schenectady.

cues.zh: 先不说找备用灯泡有多难，车头灯的性能本身也是个问题。
cues.en: Setting aside the challenge of finding spares, there’s also the issue of headlight performance.

cues.zh: 车头灯不仅对司机夜间看清路况至关重要，也可能对其他司机构成危险。
cues.en: Headlights are not only critical for the driver of a car to see at night, but they can also present a hazard to other drivers.

cues.zh: 如果太亮或照射角度不对，在别的司机眼里就成了刺眼的眩光。
cues.en: If they’re too bright or aren’t aimed correctly, in the eyes of another driver they can become the wrong kind of dazzling.

cues.zh: 这中间的界限很微妙，尽管不是所有人都能就这条线到底在哪达成一致
cues.en: There’s a fine line here, and although not everybody would agree on where exactly that line was

cues.zh: （这一点到今天依然如此！）
cues.en: (and that’s definitely still true today!)

cues.zh: 但经过大量实验和一点妥协，最终确立了一个标准的性能基准。
cues.en: with enough experimentation and a dash of compromise a standard performance benchmark was established.

cues.zh: 理想情况下，每辆车的车头灯都应达到这个标准。
cues.en: Ideally every car would have headlights that performed to that standard.

cues.zh: 要是能有办法强制所有汽车都配备符合那套标准的照明设备——
cues.en: Now, if only there were a way we could force all cars to have lighting equipment which performed to that s—

cues.zh: 哦等等，我们当年就是这么做的。
cues.en: oh wait that’s exactly what we did.

cues.zh: 从1940年到1957年售出的每一辆车，
cues.en: Every vehicle sold from 1940 until 1957,

cues.zh: 不管是别克、大众、普利茅斯还是斯图贝克，
cues.en: no matter if it was a Buick, a Volkswagen, a Plymouth, or a Studebaker,

cues.zh: 都必须能安装并配备两个这种灯。
cues.en: needed to accommodate and be equipped with two of these things.

cues.zh: 没有任何例外，这就是标准前照灯。
cues.en: No ifs, ands, or buts, this was the headlight.

cues.zh: 你可能会时不时见到一些花哨的额外灯，比如雾灯，甚至古怪的可转向灯，
cues.en: You might find some fancy extra lights from time to time, maybe fog lamps or even a wacky steerable lamp,

cues.zh: 但基础照明设备始终是同两款前照灯。
cues.en: but the basic lighting equipment was always the same two headlamps.

cues.zh: 当然，生产这种前照灯的厂商很多，有些可能比其他的稍好一点，
cues.en: Of course there were many manufacturers producing this headlamp, and some were probably a little bit better than others,

cues.zh: 但设计和规格被标准化到了这种程度：无论你开什么车，
cues.en: but the design and specifications were codified to the point that no matter what you drove,

cues.zh: 你的前照灯表现都和别人差不多，
cues.en: your headlights would perform similarly to everyone else’s,

cues.zh: 而且无论你在哪里，每家维修店和零件店都有你车的备件。
cues.en: and no matter where you were every service garage and parts store had spares for your car.

cues.zh: 因为只可能是那一样东西。
cues.en: Because there was only one thing it could be.

cues.zh: 就是这个！
cues.en: And it was this!

cues.zh: 不过，封闭式光束前照灯不仅仅是为了标准化。
cues.en: Sealed beam headlamps weren’t just for standardization, though.

cues.zh: 事实上，这个名字很重要，它解释了为什么烧坏时我们干脆把整个东西扔掉。
cues.en: In fact, the name is important and explains why we would just toss the whole thing when it burnt out.

cues.zh: 这种灯有一个金属反射镜，用来聚焦灯丝的光，
cues.en: A lamp like this has a metal reflector to focus the filament's light,

cues.zh: 而金属的问题之一就是氧化。
cues.en: and one of the problems with metal is oxidation.

cues.zh: 在封闭式光束出现之前，可更换灯泡的前照灯里的反射镜会随时间失去光泽甚至生锈，
cues.en: Before the sealed-beam, reflectors in headlights with replaceable bulbs would tarnish or even rust with time,

cues.zh: 大大削弱其效能。
cues.en: greatly diminishing their effectiveness.

cues.zh: 把反射镜密封在抽真空的玻璃外壳内，就意味着它不会失去光泽，
cues.en: Sealing the reflector inside of an evacuated glass envelope meant it wouldn’t tarnish,

cues.zh: 就算它不知怎么地还是失去了光泽——换掉就是了！
cues.en: and even if somehow it did - just replace it!

cues.zh: 而把它规定为唯一允许的前照灯，一个巨大优势是新车要适配它
cues.en: And a huge advantage of codifying this as the one and only allowed headlight was that all a new car needed to accommodate it

cues.zh: 只需要在车身上开一个尺寸合适的孔，再加一个匹配的电气连接器。
cues.en: was the right-size hole in its bodywork and the matching electrical connector.

cues.zh: 为了固定前照灯，会用锁环套住边缘，把它夹紧在接收座上，
cues.en: To secure the headlight in place a locking ring would surround the edges and clamp it to a receiving basket,

cues.zh: 而这个座可以用两颗螺丝调节，让前照灯在垂直和水平方向上都能对准。
cues.en: and the basket could be adjusted with a pair of screws to aim the headlight both vertically and horizontally.

cues.zh: 前照灯表面上的这些小凸起是用来校准的。
cues.en: These nubs on the face of the headlight were used for aiming.

cues.zh: 配合搁在它们上面的专用工具，你就能判断它们是否水平、是否正对前方。
cues.en: In conjunction with special tools which would rest on them, you could determine whether they were level and pointing dead-ahead.

cues.zh: 如果是，那就说明校准正确了——不用等到天黑才能确认。
cues.en: If they were, then you knew they were aimed correctly - no need to wait until dark to be sure.

cues.zh: 说实话，这是个考虑得相当周到的设计。
cues.en: Frankly, this was a pretty well thought-out idea.

cues.zh: 当标准基本上只是……
cues.en: Compliance with a standard is pretty easy to assure when the standard is basically just…

cues.zh: 一个特别奇怪的灯泡时，符合标准就很容易保证。
cues.en: a weirdly particular light bulb.

cues.zh: 而且汽车制造商不必对新车的车灯做任何测试或认证，因为，
cues.en: And automakers didn’t have to do any sort of testing or certification of their headlights on new cars because,

cues.zh: 我再说一遍，这就是那个前照灯！
cues.en: I say again, this was the headlight!

cues.zh: 他们只需要在车上开个孔。
cues.en: They just needed a hole for it.

cues.zh: 好吧，其实是两个孔。
cues.en: Ok, well, two.

cues.zh: 把那种瞄准装置装到车头，按规格拧好螺丝，
cues.en: Slap one of those aiming contraptions on the front of the car, set the screws accordingly,

cues.zh: 这辆车就正式符合上路法规了！
cues.en: and that there automobile is certifiably road-legal!

cues.zh: 当然，是在尾灯和其他信号灯通过认证之后。可能还有些别的事要做。
cues.en: Well, after the taillights and other signal lights were certified. Probably some other stuff to do, too.

cues.zh: 但大灯呢？
cues.en: But the headlights?

cues.zh: 那部分工作已经完成了。
cues.en: That work is already done.

cues.zh: 后来，人们（我指的是汽车高管们）对这种单大灯方案渐渐厌倦了。
cues.en: Eventually, people (by which I mean automotive executives) grew bored of this single headlight option.

cues.zh: 为了寻找新的卖点，车企最终说服了监管机构，
cues.en: Clamoring for a new selling point, automakers would eventually convince regulators of the

cues.zh: 让他们相信“装两个大灯”的魔力……
cues.en: Magic of Having Two of Them…

cues.zh: 也就是每侧两个。
cues.en: per side, that is.

cues.zh: 一种新的布局，两个略小的灯：
cues.en: A new arrangement of two slightly smaller lamps:

cues.zh: 一个是双灯丝灯泡，大致就像这个，另一个是单根高强度灯丝，用于更亮的远光灯，
cues.en: one a dual-filament lamp more or less like this one and another with a single high-intensity filament for extra bright high-beams

cues.zh: 于1957年获批使用。
cues.en: was approved for use in 1957.

cues.zh: 突然间，维修店和零件店得备齐三种不同的大灯。
cues.en: And suddenly, service shops and parts stores needed to stock three different headlights.

cues.zh: 等等，不对，老款车用的是6伏电气系统。
cues.en: Wait, no, older cars had 6 volt electrical systems.

cues.zh: 那些也得备着备件。
cues.en: Gotta keep spares for those, too.

cues.zh: 想象一下当代守旧派们那震耳欲聋的抱怨声！
cues.en: Imagine the contemporary curmudgeons’ cacophonous complaints!

cues.zh: 但我们不会止步于此！
cues.en: But we wouldn’t stop there!

cues.zh: 七十年代，没有什么比矩形更能代表“未来”了，
cues.en: In the seventies, nothing said "the future!" quite like rectangles,

cues.zh: 于是这两种方案的矩形版本获批了。
cues.en: so rectangular versions of those two schemes were approved.

cues.zh: 每侧可以用一个单一的大矩形灯，
cues.en: A single, large rectangular lamp could be used per side,

cues.zh: 或者同样允许四灯方案——但得是矩形。
cues.en: or the same quad-lamp scheme was also allowed - but rectangles.

cues.zh: 而事实上，我们甚至不会就此止步。
cues.en: And in fact we wouldn’t even stop there.

cues.zh: 如果我对这个网站匆匆一瞥没看错的话，我们最终会有十一种这种大玻璃家伙要追踪。
cues.en: If my cursory glance of this here website didn’t fail me, we would eventually have eleven of these big glass honkers to keep track of.

cues.zh: 真是可怕至极！
cues.en: How positively gruesome!

cues.zh: 不过，大多数情况下，1975年销售的汽车只有四种前大灯配置之一。
cues.en: For the most part, though, a car sold in 1975 would have one of four headlight setups.

cues.zh: 要么是这种大号单体灯，圆形或方形，
cues.en: It was either these big singles, round or square,

cues.zh: 要么是两种四灯配置之一——同样是你的选择。
cues.en: or one of the two quad setups - again, your choice.

cues.zh: 圆形或方形。
cues.en: Round or square.

cues.zh: 然而，几乎所有车型一获允许就改用矩形前大灯，
cues.en: However, virtually all models switched to rectangular headlights as soon as that was permitted,

cues.zh: 不仅因为符合当时的潮流，还因为更小的尺寸和扁平的前脸让它们在尺寸设计上更灵活。
cues.en: not only because it met the fashions of the day but their smaller size and flat front made them more dimensionally flexible.

cues.zh: 但现在你知道为什么老车都有相同的前大灯了。
cues.en: But, now you know why old cars all have the same headlights.

cues.zh: 它们只有四种选择。
cues.en: They had but four choices.

cues.zh: 这也是为什么前大灯罩和隐藏式设计开始流行。
cues.en: And that’s also why things like headlight covers and pop-up designs started spreading.

cues.zh: 如果你车头必须和其他人用一样的玻璃，
cues.en: If you had to have the same glass on the front of your car as everyone else,

cues.zh: 那为了让造型有辨识度，你就需要某种噱头！
cues.en: well to make its styling distinctive you needed some sort of gimmick!

cues.zh: 不然你也没别的办法。
cues.en: There’s only so much you can do otherwise.

cues.zh: 最后一项重大变化是卤素灯的批准。
cues.en: The last major change that would occur would be the approval of halogen lamps.

cues.zh: 没错，这实际上是对原始规格的升级。
cues.en: That’s right, this is actually an upgrade from the original specification.

cues.zh: 在1979年之前，这些东西真的只是一个标准化的、形状奇特的小灯泡，
cues.en: Before 1979, these things really were just a standardized, oddly-shaped light bulb

cues.zh: 里面有几根钨丝，就悬在反射器前方恰到好处的位置。
cues.en: with a couple of tungsten filaments just hangin' out in just the right places in front of the reflector.

cues.zh: 如果1979年对于卤素灯的创新来说听起来晚得奇怪，
cues.en: If 1979 sounds weirdly late for the innovation of halogen lights,

cues.zh: 那是因为它确实晚了。
cues.en: that’s because it was.

cues.zh: 事情发生得晚得奇怪，这算是联邦机动车安全标准的一个常见主题。
cues.en: Things happening weirdly late is kind of a running theme to the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards.

cues.zh: 录像机在卤素前照灯获批之前就已经上市了。
cues.en: Videocassette recorders would hit the market before halogen headlights were approved here.

cues.zh: 顺便说一句，我们其实不必深入探讨，但卤素灯的关键在于
cues.en: By the way, we don’t really need to get into it but the point of a halogen lamp

cues.zh: 把钨丝封装在一个充满惰性气体和少量碘或溴的小外壳里
cues.en: is that by enclosing a tungsten filament in a small envelope filled with an inert gas and a bit of iodine or maybe bromine

cues.zh: （这些元素属于……卤素）
cues.en: (those elements being among the… halogens)

cues.zh: 灯丝可以运行在更高的温度下
cues.en: the filament can be run much hotter

cues.zh: 因为热气体中漂浮的卤素分子会捕获灯丝上可能溅射出来的小碎片
cues.en: as the halogen molecules floating around in the hot gas will essentially capture little bits of the filament that might have sputtered off

cues.zh: （这通常会导致灯丝变弱、灯泡玻璃变黑）
cues.en: (which usually causes the filament to weaken and the glass of a light bulb to darken)

cues.zh: 然后把它直接贴回灯丝上，这相当疯狂。
cues.en: and it'll just slap it back onto the filament which is pretty wild.

cues.zh: 结果是，它们能发出比普通白炽灯更亮、更白的光，而且不会随着老化而损失亮度。
cues.en: The upshot is they can create a brighter and whiter light than ordinary incandescent lights and they also don’t lose brightness as they age.

cues.zh: 它们只会在某个时刻坏掉。
cues.en: They’ll just, at some point, fail.

cues.zh: 欧洲在1962年就用上了卤素前照灯，但我们没有。
cues.en: Europe got to have halogen headlights in 1962, but not us.

cues.zh: 哦，它们太亮了。
cues.en: Oh, they were much too bright.

cues.zh: 封闭式光束前照灯并非美国独有，但我们一直沿用它们……
cues.en: Now, sealed beam headlights were not unique to the US but we clung onto them for…

cues.zh: 太久了。
cues.en: too long.

cues.zh: 直到1984年还要求使用它们，说实话这很尴尬。
cues.en: Requiring them until 19 freaking 84 was frankly embarrassing.

cues.zh: 更糟的是，它们的使用限制相当严格。
cues.en: And to make matters worse, the limits on their use were quite strict.

cues.zh: 封闭式光束前照灯的一个关键缺点是，它们有点破坏车辆设计的空气动力学潜力。
cues.en: A key disadvantage of sealed beam headlights is that they kind of wreck the aerodynamic potential of a vehicle design.

cues.zh: 这个问题的一个简单解决办法是把它们放在一个凹槽里，外面盖上一块与车身轮廓吻合的造型透明罩。
cues.en: Now, a simple solution to this problem is to place them in a recess behind a sculpted clear cover which matches the contours of bodywork.

cues.zh: 但我们当时不允许这么做！
cues.en: But we didn’t allow that!

cues.zh: 事实上，我们以前是允许的，但1968年做出了决定——
cues.en: As a matter of fact, we used to, but in 1968 it was decided -

cues.zh: 不行！这些部件在使用时必须完全无遮挡。
cues.en: Nope! These have to have to be completely unobstructed when in use.

cues.zh: 这一点，再加上世界其他地方都在逐渐摒弃这类设计
cues.en: That, combined with the fact that the rest of the world was moving away from these

cues.zh: 意味着有一段相当尴尬的时期，进口车有着……
cues.en: meant that there was a rather awkward period where imported cars had…

cues.zh: 我们就直说吧，不太理想的前脸。
cues.en: let’s just call it, suboptimal faces.

cues.zh: 不过抛开造型上的后果不谈，也不全是坏事。
cues.en: Styling consequences aside, though, it wasn’t all bad.

cues.zh: 同样的根本好处依然存在——当然，丰田在日本销售的卡罗拉可能用的是不同的大灯，
cues.en: The same fundamental benefit was still there - sure, maybe Toyota’s got a different headlight on their Corollas sold in Japan,

cues.zh: 但为了让它在路上合法行驶于美国，他们不需要设计新大灯——只需要装上正确的灯座，
cues.en: but to make it road-legal in the US they didn’t need to design a new headlight — they just needed to put the right socket in place,

cues.zh: 然后，呃，尽量用边框让它看起来不那么傻。
cues.en: And, uh, try their best with bezels to make it look less goofy.

cues.zh: 不过最终，监管机构还是想通了
cues.en: Eventually, though, regulators would finally see the light

cues.zh: 允许汽车制造商尽情发挥，设计出带可更换灯泡的造型大灯。
cues.en: and allow automakers to have their fun and design sculpted headlights with replaceable lamps.

cues.zh: 1983年夏天批准了福特的申请，
cues.en: Granting Ford’s petition in the summer of ‘83,

cues.zh: 1984款林肯Continental Mark VII成为美国市场上第一款采用定制复合大灯的车型。
cues.en: the 1984 Lincoln Continental Mark VII would become the first US-market car with custom composite headlights.

cues.zh: 接下来的几年里，大多数其他车型也迅速跟进
cues.en: In the coming years, most other cars would quickly follow suit

cues.zh: 封闭式光束大灯则被降级到基础款卡车和厢式货车，以及零星的商用车上。
cues.en: and the sealed beam headlamp was relegated to base-model trucks and vans, plus commercial vehicles here and there.

cues.zh: 当然到了今天，大灯已经从一项必备配置
cues.en: Of course today, headlights have gone from a thing you just have to have

cues.zh: 变成了汽车设计中十足的宣言式元素，
cues.en: to a full-on statement piece in car design,

cues.zh: 各品牌在日间行车灯造型上玩得格外起劲。
cues.en: with brands having particular fun with daytime running light signatures.

cues.zh: 而像现代这样的品牌，甚至把事情绕回了原点
cues.en: And some brands, like Hyundai, are even bringing things full-circle

cues.zh: （或者我该说绕回了方形？）用非常复古风格的四眼日间行车灯。
cues.en: (or should I say square?) with very retro-inspired quad DRLs.

cues.zh: 你说得对，这对我来说是个巨大的吸引力。
cues.en: You’re right, this was a huge draw for me.

cues.zh: 而且它们还是前转向灯！我怎么能抗拒呢‽
cues.en: And I mean they’re also the front turn signals! How could I resist‽

cues.zh: 而且现在变好的不只是造型。
cues.en: And it’s not just styling that’s better these days.

cues.zh: 高强度气体放电和 LED 技术带来了好得多的夜间能见度，
cues.en: High-intensity discharge and LED technologies allow for much better nighttime visibility

cues.zh: 性能也大幅提升。
cues.en: through drastically improved performance.

cues.zh: 随着这些技术推广，我们也遇到了一些眩光问题——
cues.en: We’ve had some issues with glare as those technologies roll out -

cues.zh: 这方面这里的法规宽松得吓人。
cues.en: the regulations here are frightfully lenient on that front.

cues.zh: 我很高兴像 IIHS 这样的机构开始全面评估汽车前大灯性能。
cues.en: I’m glad organizations like the IIHS are starting to comprehensively review car headlight performance.

cues.zh: 这似乎是我们从允许车企自行设计车灯那一刻起就该开始做的事。
cues.en: It seems like a thing we probably should have started the moment we let automakers start fiddling with their own designs.

cues.zh: 不过，以他们标志性的及时性，眩光方面其实有好消息。
cues.en: But, with their trademark timeliness, there’s actually good news on the glare front.

cues.zh: 美国国家公路交通安全管理局首次批准了
cues.en: The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration has approved for the first time

cues.zh: 自适应光束技术，它能选择性地调暗远光灯的部分区域，
cues.en: adaptive beam technology which can selectively dim portions of the driving beam,

cues.zh: 遮挡小块区域以减少对其他司机的眩光，同时在其他地方为你保持高亮度照明。
cues.en: blocking out small regions to reduce glare for other drivers while maintaining high illumination for you everywhere else.

cues.zh: 基本上就像你的车头灯是高分辨率投影仪，摄像头说
cues.en: It’s basically like if your headlights were high resolution projectors and a camera says

cues.zh: “哦！那儿有辆车，把那个区域挡住”，但其他地方依然明亮！
cues.en: “ooh! there’s a car there, block out that part” but everything else stays bright!

cues.zh: 所以就像你一直开着远光灯，但其他司机根本察觉不到！
cues.en: So it’s like you have your high beams on all the time but other drivers don’t even know it!

cues.zh: 这项神奇的技术从2009年起就在欧洲市场应用了。
cues.en: That amazing tech has been on the European market since 2009.

cues.zh: 但在这里花了十三年才获批。
cues.en: But it took thirteen years to get approved here.

cues.zh: 我是说，至少他们打破了之前批准
cues.en: I mean, at least they beat their previous seventeen year record for approving

cues.zh: 卤素灯花了十七年的纪录！[咬牙切齿]
cues.en: halogen lamps! [through gritted teeth]

cues.zh: 不过，虽然我绝对不是要建议我们回到……
cues.en: However, while I’m definitely not about to suggest that we go back to the…

cues.zh: 黑暗时代，但像现在这样给车头灯加更多技术并非没有后果。
cues.en: dark ages, adding more technology to headlights as we do it now is not without consequences.

cues.zh: 事实上，仅仅放弃封闭式大灯并非没有代价。
cues.en: As a matter of fact, simply moving away from the sealed beam wasn’t without consequences.

cues.zh: 这些大灯模块是我为一辆1996年的Honda Civic买的
cues.en: I bought these headlight modules for a 1996 Honda Civic

cues.zh: 那还是我做转向灯同步视频的时候。
cues.en: back when I made my video on turn signal synchronization.

cues.zh: 它们便宜得惊人，一对才80美元，但它们也不是Honda的原厂零件。
cues.en: They were surprisingly inexpensive at $80 for a pair, but they’re also not a genuine Honda part.

cues.zh: 我完全不知道这些当大灯用实际表现会怎样。
cues.en: I have no idea how well these might actually perform as headlights.

cues.zh: 它们符合DOT标准……
cues.en: They are DOT compliant...

cues.zh: 据说是这样，但鉴于我之前用过这类副厂替换件的经验，
cues.en: supposedly, but having prior experience with aftermarket replacements like these,

cues.zh: 那说明不了什么。
cues.en: that doesn’t mean much.

cues.zh: 你想知道我为什么对这类副厂替换件有经验吗？
cues.en: And you wanna know why I have prior experience with aftermarket replacement like these?

cues.zh: 因为这是塑料的。
cues.en: Because this is plastic.

cues.zh: 你知道塑料经年累月暴露在紫外线下会怎样吗？
cues.en: And y’know what happens with plastic when it’s exposed to ultraviolet light over the years?

cues.zh: 会出问题，就是这样。
cues.en: Bad things, that’s what.

cues.zh: 我爸妈那辆老款小型休旅车开了大约十年后，前大灯开始变得浑浊，
cues.en: My folks’ old minivan started getting cloudy headlights after about a decade on the road,

cues.zh: 如今很多车都这样。
cues.en: as many vehicles do these days.

cues.zh: 当年我踏上了一段更换它们的旅程。
cues.en: And back in the day I embarked on a journey to replace them.

cues.zh: 我在eBay上找到了一对同样便宜的后市场大灯，
cues.en: I found a similarly inexpensive aftermarket pair on eBay,

cues.zh: 在经历了拆下汽车前脸、取出模块这通折腾之后，
cues.en: and after the absolute chore that was removing the car’s front fascia and extracting the modules,

cues.zh: 换上新的，再把一切装回去，
cues.en: replacing them, and buttoning it all back up,

cues.zh: 一辆漂亮多了的本田奥德赛出现在我眼前，但大灯只是稍微好了一点点。
cues.en: I had a much-prettier-looking Honda Odyssey staring back at me but with only marginally better headlights.

cues.zh: 新模块的光束模式和旧款完全不同，远光灯尤其平庸，
cues.en: The new modules had a completely different beam pattern from the old ones, with particularly mediocre high-beams,

cues.zh: 不管我怎么调整照射角度，效果就是不太行。
cues.en: and no matter how I adjusted their aim they just weren’t that great.

cues.zh: 关于封闭式大灯有个有趣的地方：
cues.en: And here’s a fun thing about sealed-beams:

cues.zh: 它们是玻璃做的。
cues.en: they’re made of glass.

cues.zh: 也就是说，它们不会随时间氧化发黄，而这种情况在聚碳酸酯大灯上实在太常见了。
cues.en: And that means they don’t oxidize and yellow with time as is frightfully common with polycarbonate headlights.

cues.zh: 公平地说，以前确实有这种带玻璃透镜的定制大灯。
cues.en: Now to be fair, there were bespoke headlights like this with glass lenses.

cues.zh: 也许现在有些车还在用，但如今绝对不常见了。
cues.en: Maybe some cars still have them today but it’s definitely not common these days.

cues.zh: 哦，不过你知道它们还有一个很酷的特点吗？
cues.en: Oh, but y’know another really cool feature of these?

cues.zh: 如果坏了，换个新的不到15美元。
cues.en: If they should break, a replacement costs less than $15.

cues.zh: 不用费劲去找第二代北美市场本田奥德赛的专用模块——
cues.en: No need to hunt down a specific module for a 2nd generation North American market Honda Odyssey -

cues.zh: 直接去O'Reilly或AutoZone买个新的就行。
cues.en: just pop into O’Napazone and get yourself a new one.

cues.zh: 说实话我这些还是在沃尔玛买的。
cues.en: Heck I got these at Walmart.

cues.zh: 如果你觉得封闭式大灯性能不行……
cues.en: And in case you’re thinking sealed beams just don’t perform well…

cues.zh: 老实说它们还真不赖！
cues.en: honestly they’re not half bad!

cues.zh: 我开过四种常见配置中的三种：四矩形、双矩形和双圆形。
cues.en: I’ve driven cars with three of the four common setups: quad rectangles, dual rectangles, and dual roundies.

cues.zh: 说实话？以我自认主观的眼光来看，
cues.en: And frankly? To my admittedly subjective eyes,

cues.zh: 它们都高于平均水平。
cues.en: they were all better than average.

cues.zh: 作为一个经常在乡间小路上留意鹿的人，
cues.en: As someone who spends a good deal of time on country roads looking out for deer,

cues.zh: 这两款车远光灯的照射效果都优于我开过的大多数现代汽车。
cues.en: the throw of the high beams from either of these is superior to most modern cars I’ve driven.

cues.zh: 不骗你，事实上，在照亮开阔道路方面，它们甚至可以说比我新车还要好一点。
cues.en: And I’m not kidding you, in fact, these are arguably a bit better at lighting up the open road than even my new car.

cues.zh: 不过，在蜿蜒曲折的路上它们就吃力多了——封闭式大灯的光斑非常集中，这在直道上很棒，
cues.en: They struggle a LOT, though, on the curvy windies - sealed beams have a very focused spot which is great for straightaways,

cues.zh: 但只要稍微转弯（哪怕只是翻过一个小山头），你就会希望有更宽广的照明覆盖。
cues.en: but start curving even slightly (or even just crest a hill) and you’ll wish for more broad coverage.

cues.zh: 所以总的来说，我还是更愿意用我新车上那套现代 LED 灯组，
cues.en: So I’d still rather have my new car’s modern LED setup on balance,

cues.zh: 但封闭式大灯也没那么糟糕。
cues.en: but it’s not as if sealed beams are terrible.

cues.zh: 因为有趣的是，当整个前照灯坏掉时更换它意味着……
cues.en: Because, and here’s the fun thing, replacing the entire headlight when it goes out means…

cues.zh: 嗯，每次坏掉你都能得到一个全新的前照灯！
cues.en: well you’re getting an entirely new headlight every time it goes out!

cues.zh: 而且这些灯随着时间推移确实越来越好，事实上Sylvania甚至推出了这些灯的Silverstar版本。
cues.en: And these actively got better over time, in fact Sylvania even makes Silverstar versions of these.

cues.zh: 想想1979年之前制造的汽车——以今天的标准来看，它们的前照灯糟糕透了。
cues.en: Think about cars made prior to 1979 - they had terrible headlights by today’s standards.

cues.zh: 甚至连卤素灯都不是。
cues.en: Not even halogen.

cues.zh: 但是，因为它们都和其他同时代汽车一样有相同的前照灯插座，
cues.en: But, because they all have the same headlight sockets as any other contemporary car,

cues.zh: 我可以直接装一个进去，突然间它们就有了来自未来几十年的前照灯技术！
cues.en: I could slap one of these in and suddenly they have headlight tech from decades in the future!

cues.zh: 而且不只是卤素技术，哦不。
cues.en: And it’s not just halogen tech, oh no.

cues.zh: 因为这些东西太大了，现在有了配备现代光学元件的完整LED直接替换件，
cues.en: Because these things are so large, there are now full-on LED drop-in replacements with modern optics,

cues.zh: 通过了DOT认证等等。
cues.en: DOT approved and everything.

cues.zh: 没必要搞那种绝对不合法的 HID 套件，
cues.en: No need to get all sketchy with a definitely-not-road-legal HID kit,

cues.zh: 只要简单换个车灯，一辆 1950 年的车就能用上 2022 年的车灯技术。
cues.en: just a simple headlight swap and a car from 1950 can have headlight tech from 2022.

cues.zh: 或者至少，2010 年的吧。
cues.en: Or at least, like, 2010.

cues.zh: 好吧，这确实会彻底毁掉那辆车的外观，但如果是车队用车呢？
cues.en: Yeah OK this would totally ruin the look of that car, but for a fleet vehicle?

cues.zh: 何乐而不为？
cues.en: Why not?

cues.zh: 说到底，我们基本已经抛弃这个思路了，这也说得通。
cues.en: In the end, it makes sense that we’ve mostly moved on from this concept.

cues.zh: 有些新车，通常是大巴和卡车这类大块头，还在用封闭式光束大灯，但
cues.en: Some new vehicles, typically big things like buses and trucks, are still getting made which use sealed beam headlamps, but

cues.zh: 如今已经很少见了。
cues.en: it’s pretty rare to see these days.

cues.zh: 同样常见的是，路上跑的厢式货车随便装个现成的汽车大灯模块，
cues.en: It seems just as common to find a box truck roaming around with some off-the-shelf car headlight module slapped on,

cues.zh: 比如，呃，这些 UPS 卡车装的就是 Oldsmobile Alero 的大灯。
cues.en: like, uh, for instance these UPS trucks with headlights from an Oldsmobile Alero.

cues.zh: 但说实话，设计师费这么大劲，我总觉得挺奇怪的。
cues.en: But frankly, it always seems odd to me when designers go through that trouble.

cues.zh: 直接装个封闭式大灯，配上现成的指示灯和侧标志灯就行了！
cues.en: Just stick a sealed beam in there with an off-the-shelf indicator and side marker!

cues.zh: 完全合法上路，一点麻烦都没有，而且通常还能让车看起来好看不少。
cues.en: Road legal with literally none of that trouble, and it usually makes the vehicle look much better, too.

cues.zh: 我是说，我明白你想表达什么，
cues.en: I mean, I see what you were going for here,

cues.zh: 但这辆卡车看起来友善多了。
cues.en: but this other truck is much more friend-shaped.

cues.zh: 新乘用车还会再用封闭式大灯出售吗？
cues.en: Will new passenger cars get sold again with sealed beam headlights?

cues.zh: 大概不会了。
cues.en: Probably not.

cues.zh: 但我确实有点希望，我们能把类似的东西带进未来。
cues.en: But I do kinda hope we bring something like them into the future with us.

cues.zh: 现代汽车大灯模块里往往根本没有可维修的部件，而且更换起来也不便宜。
cues.en: Modern car headlight modules often have nothing serviceable in there at all, and they’re not cheap to replace.

cues.zh: 它们有很多优点，而有了 LED，我们可以期望它们能用一辈子。
cues.en: There’s a lot to like about them, and with LEDs we can hope that they last the life of the car.

cues.zh: 如果设计得当，本该如此，但现实世界往往另有优先考量。
cues.en: If they were designed right they should but the real world tends to have other priorities.

cues.zh: 当然，2022年强制所有汽车使用相同的大灯是行不通的。
cues.en: Sure, in 2022 mandating that cars all use the same headlights ain’t gonna fly.

cues.zh: [音乐渐入] 但你得承认，这主意还不算最糟。
cues.en: [music fades in] But you have to admit this wasn’t the worst idea.

cues.zh: [音乐戛然而止] 开玩笑的！在花絮之前，我有个冷知识要告诉你。
cues.en: [music ends abruptly] Just kidding! I have a piece of trivia for you before the bloopers.

cues.zh: 你可能知道我一时兴起在疫情前买的那辆荒唐小车。
cues.en: You may know of my absurd little car I bought on a whim in the before times.

cues.zh: 它完全是为了极致古怪而存在，日产Figaro的复古设计使命
cues.en: existing entirely as an exercise in excessive eccentricity, the Nissan Figaro’s vintage design mission

cues.zh: 采用了大灯，本意是看起来像封闭式光束灯
cues.en: incorporated headlights that are meant to look like sealed beams

cues.zh: 但实际上并不是。
cues.en: but in fact they are not.

cues.zh: 而这实际上非常令人失望。
cues.en: And that is actually a massive bummer.

cues.zh: 你看，很多人从右舵国家进口车辆时没意识到的一件事
cues.en: See one of those things many people don’t realize when they import a vehicle from a wrong-hand-drive country

cues.zh: 就是大灯是反的。
cues.en: is that the headlights are backwards.

cues.zh: 近光灯设置下的大灯通常是不对称的。
cues.en: Headlights on the low-beam setting are generally not symmetrical.

cues.zh: 它们的设计是把更多光线投向路肩，更少光线照向对向来车。
cues.en: They are designed to throw more light towards the shoulder and less light towards oncoming traffic.

cues.zh: 这通常是通过倾斜的光束截止线来实现的，
cues.en: Often this is accomplished through a slanted beam cutoff,

cues.zh: Figaro 的大灯就是这样。
cues.en: and that’s the case with the Figaro’s headlights.

cues.zh: 但是，你看，这方向反了！
cues.en: But, see, that’s backwards!

cues.zh: 这车本应在日本行驶，那里是靠左行驶的，
cues.en: It’s supposed to be driven in Japan where they drive on the left side of the road,

cues.zh: 所以它把更多光线投向左侧，更少投向右侧。
cues.en: so it’s throwing more light to the left and less light to the right.

cues.zh: 这让它在美国夜间行驶时简直吓人。
cues.en: That makes driving it at night here in the US absolutely terrifying.

cues.zh: 能见度极差，我有一次离人行道上的行人只有几米远才看见对方。
cues.en: Visibility is atrocious and I once got to within just a few meters of a pedestrian on the sidewalk before I even saw them.

cues.zh: 他们在人行道上，所以不算什么险情
cues.en: They were on the sidewalk so it wasn’t a close call or anything

cues.zh: 但把我吓得够呛。
cues.en: but that scared the crap out of me.

cues.zh: 我不再在夜间开那辆车了。
cues.en: I don’t drive that car at night anymore.

cues.zh: 这不是瞄准的问题！
cues.en: And it’s not an aim issue!

cues.zh: 事实上，这车的远光灯很棒！
cues.en: As a matter of fact, the car's high-beams are great!

cues.zh: 有一次时机不巧，我晚上开着Figaro在乡下，能用远光灯的时候呢？
cues.en: Poor timing once caught me out in the country at night in the Figaro and when I could use the high beams?

cues.zh: 看什么都清清楚楚！
cues.en: No problem seeing anything!

cues.zh: 但一有对向来车，
cues.en: But as soon as there was oncoming traffic,

cues.zh: 切换近光灯后路肩的能见度太差，只要不能开远光，我就得减速到每小时40英里。
cues.en: dipping the headlights limited visibility on the shoulder so much that I slowed down to 40 miles an hour whenever I couldn’t keep the brights on.

cues.zh: 就是这么糟糕。
cues.en: It’s that bad.

cues.zh: 这车根本不往右侧投光。
cues.en: The car just doesn't throw any light to the right.

cues.zh: 而且，既然这车确实往左侧朝对向车流投光，
cues.en: And, since the car IS throwing light to the left at oncoming traffic,

cues.zh: 我就老被人闪远光灯。说实话，我活该。
cues.en: I kept getting brights flashed at me. And frankly I deserved it.

cues.zh: 如果这车用的是封闭式大灯，而且尺寸合适，
cues.en: If the car had sealed beam headlights and they were the right size

cues.zh: 我直接换成美规的就行了，但可惜这车没这个选项。
cues.en: I could just swap them out for US-spec ones and be done with it but unfortunately that’s not really an option with this car.

cues.zh: 有个套件本来是用来做这个的，但是，你看，
cues.en: There is a kit which is meant to do this, but, see,

cues.zh: 大灯的玻璃是顺着车身形状弯曲的——这其实就露馅了，说明这些并不是真正的封闭式大灯。
cues.en: the glass of the headlights curves with the shape of the body - that’s actually the giveaway that these aren’t really sealed beams.

cues.zh: 所以就算你能把这种美规封闭式大灯装进那些孔位里，它们看起来也永远不对劲。
cues.en: So while you can fit a US-spec sealed beam like this in those holes, they'll never look right.

cues.zh: 而且既然这是辆傻乎乎的小玩具车，肯定算得上史上最不实用的车之一，
cues.en: And since this is a silly little toy car which must be among the least practical cars ever built,

cues.zh: 它又老、又小、又轻，基本没啥碰撞安全性，本来开上路就挺冒险的，晚上更是如此，
cues.en: and it’s old, small, light and barely crashworthy, thus kinda risky to be driving in the first place but especially at night,

cues.zh: 我觉得还是就让它保持原样吧。
